home.description: What this template is and what you will find inside

form.description: Form with grouped fields, required validation and the main data types

chart.description: ChartLine with two static series, dashed comparison, bounded axis and full styling. Other variants: ChartArea, ChartBar, ChartColumn, ChartScatter, ChartDonut, ChartPie, ChartMixed, ChartRadar, ChartRadialBar, ChartHeatmap, ChartCandlestick

dashboard.description: PeriodSelector, KpiCard, ChartCard and TopListCard wired to the same period scope: change the period and every card refetches

tableView.description: TableView backed by a demo Mongo collection: filter tabs, searchable, filterable and sortable columns, CRUD row actions, archive mode and export

tree.description: Tree with static nodes, multi-selection propagation, default expansion and custom icons

tab.description: Tab with icons, badges, keyboard shortcuts, a disabled item and persisted active tab

grid.description: Grid with rows, colSpan and a nested Grid — the building blocks of dashboard layouts

stack.description: HStack, VStack and Spacer combined into an app shell: header, sidebar and content

placeholder.description: Placeholder with label and fixed dimensions — used to sketch layouts before real content

custom.description: A project-defined Vue component registered through a local nuxt-layer and rendered with CustomComponent

users.description: The people of the demo app, used as relation target by the tasks

projects.description: The projects of the demo app, used as relation target by the tasks

tasks.description: Tasks linked to a project and an assignee through relation columns

modules.title: CMS modules
modules.description: Every feature module is installed and enabled in this template.

how.title: How it works
how.description: Everything you see is declared by the local module in src/ — pages are TypeScript classes, data lives in MongoDB, and custom widgets ship through a local Nuxt layer.

pages.title: 1. Declare pages
pages.description: PageController classes in src/ register pages, categories and components.

data.description: Static datasets, demo API endpoints or Mongo tables with fixtures.
